source: BLS official release schedules for CPI + Employment Situation, recovered via Internet Archive Wayback snapshots (bls.gov 403s this host directly)
url_or_api_call: https://web.archive.org/web/<ts>id_/https://www.bls.gov/schedule/news_release/{cpi,empsit}.htm — 15 snapshots, ~1-2 per year 2021-2026 (timestamps in raw_wayback_snapshots/ filenames + wayback_snapshot_date column)
date_range: release dates 2020-11-06..2026-12-10 (12 per release per year 2021-2026 + 2 tail-2020 rows)
granularity: per-release rows: release_name, reference_month, date, time_et (24h ET), status, wayback_snapshot_date
publication_lag: EXEMPT from lag arithmetic per D-057 (scheduled calendar, dates announced months ahead); the release EVENT itself fires at time_et (08:30 ET for every row) on 'date'
caveats: CONTEXT event calendar. status column: 'actual' = the release date was in the past at the snapshot capture (it happened); 'scheduled_at_capture' = only ever seen as a future scheduled date. Conflicting reschedules resolved by LATEST snapshot per (release, reference_month) — this correctly captures the late-2025 government-shutdown chaos: Sep-2025 CPI actual 2025-10-24 (not the scheduled 10-15), Sep-2025 Employment Situation actual 2025-11-20 (not 10-03), Nov-2025 empsit actual 2025-12-16, Nov-2025 CPI actual 2025-12-18. CAUTION: the two October-2025-reference rows (empsit 2025-11-07, CPI 2025-11-13) are scheduled_at_capture and those releases were disrupted/cancelled in the shutdown — do NOT flag those dates as release events without independent confirmation. Future-dated 2026 rows are the official schedule, revisable. VERIFIED: NFP rows land on first Fridays (e.g. 2025-02-07, 2025-03-07); CPI Feb-2024 on 2024-03-12 matches the public record; all times 08:30 AM as expected.

source: raw Wayback captures (gzip-decompressed where the capture was stored compressed)
